blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How compound meanings are best predicted from constituent meanings remains a central question in computational models of lexical semantics. Comparing different computational models provides a way to evaluate alternative accounts of how semantic information is combined during compound comprehension. We propose a new model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that predicts a compound’s embedding by adding its constituent embeddings together with the average shift vectors of the two constituents’ compound families. The resulting model is parameter-free and exploits local analogical structure in the semantic space. We evaluated CAM against the CAOSS model (Guenther and Marelli, 2023) on 44,731 Mandarin Chinese compounds. Computational experiments showed that CAM consistently achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both training and held-out data, with the exception of three-character compounds, for which analogical generalization is constrained by both small constituent families and a pronounced imbalance in family size between the two constituents. The advantage of CAM remained when evaluation was based on frequency-defined train–test splits that better approximate generalization from familiar to novel compounds. To assess the cognitive plausibility of the two models, we further examined whether model-derived semantic measures predict visual lexical decision latencies for two-character compounds. Generalized additive models showed that predictors derived from CAM provided improved prediction for response latencies compared to predictors derived from the CAOSS model. In addition, the length (L2-norm) of the predicted compound embedding emerged as an important predictor, suggesting that embedding magnitude contributes independently to lexical processing. These findings indicate that compound meaning is better characterized as local analogical generalization than as the application of a learned global linear transformation, and demonstrate that analogical semantic structure provides a cognitively plausible basis for compound comprehension.
blocks.zh: 复合意义如何从组成意义中最佳地预测,仍然是词汇语义学计算模型中的一个中心问题. 比较不同的计算模型,提供了一种方法,用以评价语义信息在复合理解过程中如何结合的替代说法. 我们提出一个新的模型,即复合性分析模型(Cample Analogy Model,CAM),它通过将复合性组分的嵌入与两个组成性组分家族的平均移向量相加来预测复合性组分的嵌入。 由此形成的模型是无参数的并利用了语义空间中的局部模拟结构. 我们对照CAOSS模型(Guenther and Marelli, 2023)对44,731个普通汉语化合物进行了CAM评价. 计算实验表明,CAM在培训和停产数据方面始终达到高于CAOSS的预测准确性,但三个特征化合物除外,它们之间的类似通用性受到小组成家庭的限制,而且两个组成家庭之间的家庭规模明显不平衡。 在根据频率定义的列车进行评估时,CAM的优势依然存在,这种测试将比较接近一般化,从熟悉的化合物到新颖的化合物。 为了评估这两个模型的认知性,我们进一步审查了模型衍生的语义量度是否预测了两种特征化合物的视觉地法决定延迟. 一般添加剂模型显示,与CAOSS模型的预测器相比,来自CAM的预测器提供了更好的反应延迟预测. 此外,所预测的化合物嵌入的长度(L2-Norm)作为一个重要的预测器而出现,说明嵌入量能独立地促进词汇处理. 这些发现表明,复合含义被更好的定性为局部类比通论,而不是应用已学到的全球线性变迁,并表明类比语义结构为复合理解提供了一种认知上可信的基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Compounds are words that consist of two or more words. Compounding is a widespread word-formation process, and often one of the most productive means for creating names for novel concepts. At the same time, many compounds have meanings that are not straightforwardly predictable from the meanings of their constituents. An apple tree is a tree that bears apples, but the meaning of hogwash , ‘nonsense’, is hard to predict from the meanings of hog and wash ; moonshine refers to illicit liquor rather than the light of the moon. Many studies have addressed the consequences of semantic transparency, or the lack thereof, for lexical processing and representation ( Zwitserlood, 1994 ; Sandra, 1990 ; Libben et al., 2003 ; Libben et al., 2018 ; Libben, 2014 ; Libben and Jarema, 2006 ; Pham and Baayen, 2015 ; Günther and Marelli, 2019 ; Ji et al., 2011 ; Janssen et al., 2008 ; Bien et al., 2005 ) . Compounds therefore provide a particularly informative test case for theories of semantic composition, because they require the cognitive system to relate constituent meanings to whole-word meanings while allowing for substantial variation in how predictable these relations are.
blocks.zh: 复合词是由两个或两个以上词组成的词. 复合体是一个广泛的词形化过程,往往是为新概念创造名字最有成果的手段之一. 同时,许多化合物的含意也从成分的含义上看并不直接可预见. 苹果树是一棵有苹果的树,但"无心"("nogwash")的含义很难从"猪"和"洗"的含义来预测;"月光"指的是非法酒而不是月光. 许多研究探讨了语义透明度或缺乏语义透明度对词汇处理和表述的影响(Zwitserloud,1994年;Sandra,1990年;Libben等,2003年;Libben等,2018年;Libben,2014年;Libben和Jarema,2006年;Pham和Baayen,2015年;Günther和Marelli,2006年)。 2019; Ji等, 2011; Janssen等, 2008; Bien等, 2005.). 因此,复合物为语义组成理论提供了特别翔实的测试案例,因为它们要求认知系统将组成意义与全词意义联系起来,同时允许这些关系的可预见性发生很大变化.

blocks.en: Approaches in psychology to written comprehension of morphologically complex words can broadly be divided into symbolic and subsymbolic theories. Within the symbolic camp, one theory argues that during reading the very first processing step is morphological decomposition ( Taft, 2004 ; Rastle et al., 2004 ; Marantz, 2013 ) . Others have argued that information about constituents only becomes available after a complex word as a whole has been recognized ( Giraudo and Grainger, 2001 ) . Yet others have claimed that decompositional and whole-word driven access operate in parallel ( Baayen et al., 1997 ; Kuperman et al., 2009 ) . The disagreement concerns the stage at which meaning becomes relevant: is hogwash first chunked into hog and wash , with subsequent processes linking these to words to the meaning ‘nonsense’? Or is hogwash immediately understood to mean ‘nonsense’? Evidence for initial meaning-free morpho-orthographic segmentation ( Rastle et al., 2004 ; Smolka et al., 2009 , e.g.) is matched by counter-evidence pointing to confounds with degrees of semantic relatedness ( Gonnerman et al., 2007 ; Baayen and Smolka, 2020 ; Chuang et al., 2022 ; Marelli et al., 2013 ) and independently, evidence for an early role of whole-word knowledge in reading ( Schmidtke et al., 2017 ; Pham and Baayen, 2015 ) and evidence that more proficient readers scan complex words with fewer fixations ( Kuperman and Van Dyke, 2011 ) . Important for the present study is that all symbolic theories agree that at some point, the constituents of a compound and the compound itself are considered jointly. The more a compound is semantically opaque, the greater the conflict between the meanings of the constituents and the meaning of the compound is that the cognitive system has to resolve.
blocks.zh: 心理学中对形态复杂词作书面理解的方法可以大致分为符号理论和子符号理论. 在象征性阵营中,一种理论认为,在阅读过程中,第一个处理步骤是形态分解(Taft,2004;Rastle等,2004;Marantz,2013)。 另一些人则认为,只有在一个复杂的词作为一个整体得到承认之后,才能获得关于成分的信息(Giraudo和Grainger,2001年)。 还有一些人声称,分解和整词驱动的准入平行进行(Baayen等人,1997年;Kuperman等人,2009年)。 分歧涉及意义变得相关的阶段:猪先被分解成猪并被洗涤,随后的过程将这些与词与"不理智"的含义联系起来? 或者霍格瓦什立即被理解为"不理智"? 初步无含义的morpho-orthographic spection的证据(Rastle等,2004年;Smolka等,2009年等)与反证据相匹配,指出与语义相关程度的混淆(Gonnerman等,2007年;Baayen和Smolka,2020年;Chuang等,2022年;Marelli等,2013年)和独立的证据,说明全词知识在阅读中的早期作用(Smitke等,2017年;Pham和Baayen,2015年),以及更熟练的读者用较少的修饰来扫描复杂词的证据(Kuperman和Van Dyke,2011年)。 对于本研究很重要的是,所有象征性的理论都同意,在某个时候,一个化合物的成分和该化合物本身被一并考虑. 一个化合物越是凝聚的不透明,成分的意义和化合物的意义之间的冲突越大,就是认知系统必须解决.

blocks.en: For subsymbolic models it is less clear how the meanings of both constituents and the compound itself could be considered jointly. For the triangle model of Harm and Seidenberg (2004) , it might be possible to trace constituent effects back to hidden layers and whole-word recognition to activation at the semantic output layer. By contrast, the Discriminative Lexicon Model ( Chuang et al., 2022 ; Heitmeier et al., 2026 , DLM) typically operates with networks without a hidden layer (but see Heitmeier et al., 2025 , for implementations using deep networks) , and directs attention to a compound’s semantic embedding that is predicted from a compound’s form embedding. As shown by Bell and Baayen (2026) for English compounds, it is letter n-grams straddling the morpheme boundary (e.g., gw in hogwash ) that are most informative for the meaning of the compound. For compounds encountered during training, the model learns to exploit the high information load of these boundary n-grams. However, for novel compounds, the model has no prior experience with the boundary n-grams, and hence cannot predict their meanings. In this, the model is not alone: Schäfer and Bell (2020) report for English that native speakers also struggle with making sense of novel compounds. Nevertheless, it is clear that language users (and not only linguists) can see hog and wash in hogwash ( Libben, 2014 ) , and that non-specialists can be conscious of the discrepancy between the meaning of the compound and the meanings of its constituents.
blocks.zh: 对于子同义模型,如何将成分和化合物本身的含义一并考虑则不太明确. 对于Harm和Seidenberg的三角模型(2004年),也许可以追溯到隐藏地层和全字识别,以便在语义输出地层活化. 相形之下,区别性Lexicon模型(Chuang等,2022;Heitmeier等,2026,DLM)一般使用没有隐藏层的网络运行(但Heitmeier等,2025年,关于使用深层网络的实施),并引导人们注意从化合物的嵌入形式中预言的化合物的语义嵌入. 如Bell和Baayen(2026年)所显示的,是正克字母跨越morpheme边界(例如:gw in hogwash),对化合物的意义最有信息. 对于在训练中遇到的化合物,模型学习利用这些边界n克的高信息负荷. 然而,对于新颖的化合物,该模型在边界正克上没有之前的经验,因此无法预测其含义. 在这个模式中,这个模式不单是:Schäfer和Bell(2020年)为英语报告,当地人演讲者也为让新颖的化合物感同身受. 尽管如此,语言使用者(并不仅仅是语言学家)可以看见猪并用猪头来洗涤(Libben,2014年),非专家可以意识到化合物的含义与其成分的含义之间的相差.

blocks.en: It seems likely that in compound processing, different kinds of cognitive processes are involved. One useful distinction is that between Basic Language Cognition (BLC) and the Enhanced Literate Mind (ELM) ( Huettig and Hulstijn, 2025 ) . BLC is the cognitive system that makes informal oral conversation possible. This system is mastered by all non-impaired speakers, irrespective of education and intelligence. It operates mostly subliminally, and is highly automatized. ELM, by contrast pertains to the cognitive skills that come with extensive training in literacy. Whereas BLC is unproblematic for the general population, approximately one out of 10 people have some form of dyslexia, and for the rest of the population, reading skills vary widely (see Kuperman and Van Dyke, 2011 , for the consequences for the lexical processing of complex words) . The distinction between BLC and ELM is probably fairly fluid and not as discrete as Huettig and Hulstijn (2025) suggest. Specifically, for highly proficient readers, automation of reading skills may lead to efficient subliminal processing similar to automated processing in BLC. The DLM ( Heitmeier et al., 2026 ) , and probably also the triangle model ( Harm and Seidenberg, 2004 ) , capture these BLC-like subliminal processes in proficient reading, and require complementation by mechanisms that underlie literate speakers’ abilities to, e.g., provide ratings of how similar the meanings of compounds’ constituents and the compound meanings themselves are.
blocks.zh: 在化合物处理中,似乎可能涉及不同类型的认知过程. 一个有用的区别是基本语言认知(BLC)和增强的文学意识(ELM)(Huettig和Hulstijn,2025. BLC是认知系统,使得非正式口语交谈成为可能. 该系统由所有非残疾的演讲者掌握,不论教育和智力如何。 其运作大多为下级,并高度自发. 与此相对照的是,识字教育与认识技能有关,这些技能伴随着广泛的扫盲培训。 虽然BLC对于一般人群来说是没有问题的,但大约十分之一的人有某种形式的障碍症,而对于其他人群来说,阅读技能差别很大(见克普尔曼和范德克,2011年,关于复杂词的词汇处理的后果). BLC和ELM之间的区别可能相当灵活,不像Huettig和Hulstijn(2025年)所暗示的那样离散. 具体地说,对于高度熟练的阅读者来说,阅读技能的自动化可能导致类似于BLC中自动化处理的高效地下潜处理. DLM(Heitmeier等,2026年),以及可能还有三角模型(Harm and Seidenberg,2004年),在熟练阅读时捕捉到这些类似BLC的潜入过程,并需要通过作为识字者能力基础的机制加以补充,例如,提供对化合物成分的含义和复合含义本身的相似性的评级。

blocks.en: Regardless of whether lexical processing is assumed to proceed through symbolic or sub-symbolic mechanisms, all theories ultimately require an account of how constituent meanings give rise to compound meanings. Two broad accounts have been proposed. One explains compound meaning in terms of semantic relations between constituents, whereas the other derives compound meaning directly in a semantic vector space. Within the latter account, the present study tests whether compound meaning is better characterized as reflecting a learned global transformation or local analogical generalization.
blocks.zh: 不论词典处理是假定通过符号机制还是子符号机制进行,所有理论最终都要求说明组成意义如何产生复合意义. 提出了两个广泛的说明。 一个解释复合含义在成分之间的语义关系,而另一个解释直接在语义矢量空间中产生复合含义. 在后一种情况中,本研究检验复合含义是否更好定性为反映已了解的全球转变或局部模拟通论。

blocks.en: According to the CARIN theory of Gagné and Shoben (1997) ; Gagné et al. (2005) , readers have knowledge of the possible semantic relations ( Lees, 1960 ; Levy, 1978 ) that may exist in a language, and that guide interpretation. For instance, a silk shirt is a shirt made of silk, and a bookshelf is a shelf for books. According to Gagné and Shoben (1997) , the semantic relation that is the most frequent for the first constituent guides interpretation. However, assigning a unique semantic relation to a compound has proven difficult. Schmidtke et al. (2018) showed that, among 600 English compounds, only two received unanimous agreement on a single semantic relation from a predefined set of 16 relations, while the median number of relations selected for each compound exceeded five. These findings suggest that semantic composition cannot be fully captured by manually crafted relational categories.
blocks.zh: 根据Gagné和Shoben的CARIN理论(1997年);Gagné等人(2005年),读者对一种语言中可能存在的语义关系(Les,1960年;Levy,1978年)有了解,而这种解释是指导性的。 例如,丝绸衬衫是用丝绸制成的衬衫,而书架则是书架. 根据Gagné和Shoben(1997年),最早的构成指南解释中最常出现的语义关系. 然而,事实证明,很难确定与某一化合物的独特语义关系。 Schmidtke等 (2018年) 显示,在600个英国化合物中,只有2个从一套预先确定的16个关系中获得关于单一语义关系的一致协议,而为每个化合物选择的关系中位数则超过5个. 这些调查结果表明,人工制作的关系类别无法充分反映语义成分。

blocks.en: Günther and Marelli (2019) ; Günther et al. (2020) ; Günther and Marelli (2023) argue that compound interpretation is guided by a general function that takes the embeddings of the constituents of a compound as input and produces the embedding of the compound as output. The technical details of their CAOSS model will be introduced in detail below (section 3.1 ). The CAOSS model can be seen as a model that provides a measure of the semantic transparency of a compound: the more closely the model succeeds in approximating the true, gold-standard compound embedding, the more transparent that compound must be. The model can also be seen as providing a mechanism for obligatory decomposition models that specifies how the meanings of a compound’s constituents can produce the meaning of the compound. CAOSS can also be interpreted as providing a computationally explicit characterization of the cognitive subsystem that readers use when asked to provide semantic similarity ratings. From a linguistic perspective, CAOSS is important theoretically because it proposes there is a single semantic operation underlying compounding that is similar to the semantic operations proposed earlier for derivation ( Marelli and Baroni, 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: Günther和Marelli (2019年); Günther等 (2020年); Günther和Marelli (2023年) 认为,复合解释以一般函数为指导,将化合物成分的嵌入作为输入并产生化合物的嵌入作为输出. 下文将详细介绍其CAOSS模型的技术细节(第3.1节)。 CAOSS模型可以被看作一个模型,它提供了一个化合物语义上透明度的度量:模型越接近地成功地将真,金-标准化合物嵌入,化合物必须更加透明. 该模型也可被视为为强制分解模型提供了一种机制,规定化合物成分的含义如何产生化合物的含义。 CAOSS还可以被解释为对读者在被要求提供语义相似性评分时使用的认知子系统提供计算明确的定性. 从语言学的角度来看,CAOSS在理论上很重要,因为它提出有一个基于复合的单一语义操作,它与早先提出的衍生语义操作类似(Marelli and Baroni, 2015.).

blocks.en: Although the hypothesis of a general semantic operation driving compound interpretation is interesting, the present study explores an alternative computational principle: compound interpretation as local analogical generalization. Analogical reasoning has been formalized in many ways ( Skousen, 1989 ; Skousen et al., 2002 ; Nosofsky, 1990 ; Daelemans and Van den Bosch, 2005 , see, e.g.) . The core idea is that generalization is based on majority trends in similarity neighborhoods: rather than applying a universal rule, the system exploits structure present among similar instances. For the understanding of the form and meaning of compounds, analogical approaches have proved to be useful in many respects. CARIN ( Gagné and Shoben, 1997 ; Gagné et al., 2005 ) is an analogical theory that defines the similarity neighborhood to be provided by the left constituent family of a compound, and selects the most frequent semantic relation in that family as the basis for generalization. Schäfer and Bell (2020) point out that the higher the uncertainty of a reader about the concept represented by the second constituent of an English compound, based on existing compounds with that second constituent, the greater the diversity of interpretations across readers, and the more difficult it is for these readers to imagine an interpretation. These authors take the compounds sharing the same second constituent as providing the similarity neighborhood, and suggest that analogical generalization becomes more difficult the more diverse the senses of the second constituent are.
blocks.zh: 虽然一般语义操作驱动复合解释的假说很有意思,但本研究探索了另一种计算原理:复合解释作为局部模拟通论. 逻辑推理在许多方面已经正式化(Skousen,1989年;Skousen等,2002年;Nosofsky,1990年;Daelemans和Van den Bosch,2005年,见,例如)。 其核心思想是通论是基于相似性街区的多数趋势:系统不是应用通则,而是利用类似实例中存在的结构. 为了了解化合物的形式和含义,模拟方法在许多方面证明是有用的。 CARIN(Gagné and Shoben,1997;Gagné等,2005年)是一种类比理论,它定义了一个化合物的左组成家族提供的相似性邻接,并选择该家族中最常出现的语义关系作为通论的基础. Schäfer和Bell (2020)指出,一个读者对于一个英语化合物的第二组成物所代表概念的不确定性越高,基于该第二组成物的现有复合物,读者间解释的多样性越大,这些读者想象解释的难度就越高. 这些作者将共享与提供相似性相邻的同为第二成份的化合物取而代之,并暗示模拟通论越是第二成份的感官越多,其难度就越大.

blocks.en: With respect to compounds’ forms, it has been observed that English compounds that share the same first, or second, constituent tend to be stressed in the same way ( Plag, 2010 ; Bell and Plag, 2013 ) . Another area where analogical generalization plays a role is the interfixes (also known as linking elements) that are found in German and Dutch compounds. Interfixes are rare in English ( helm-s-man is an example), but they occur frequently in German and Dutch. In Dutch, schaap-herder (‘shepherd’) has no interfix, schaap-s-kooi (‘sheep stable’) has the -s- interfix, and shaap-e-vlees (‘mutton’) has the -e- interfix. Both speakers and listeners have strong intuitions about which interfix is most appropriate for both existing and novel compounds, namely, the interfix that has the greatest prevalence in the left constituent family of a compound ( Krott et al., 2001 ; Krott et al., 2007 ; Krott et al., 2004 ) . Here, the analogical similarity set is again the compound family of the first constituent, just as in CARIN theory.
blocks.zh: 关于化合物的形态,据观察,具有相同第一或第二成分的英国化合物往往以同样的方式被强调(Plag,2010;Bell and Plag,2013.). 模拟通化起作用的另一个领域是德语和荷兰语化合物所发现的相接元素(也叫相接元素). 相接器在英语中是罕见的(掌舵-s-man是一个例子),但经常在德语和荷兰语中出现. 在荷兰语中,schaap-herder("shepherd")没有接字,schaap-s-kooi("羊稳定")有-s-接字,而shaap-e-vlees("mutton")有-e接字. 发言者和听众都具有很强的直觉,认为哪一种接字最适合现有和新颖的化合物,即一种化合物在左组别家庭中最流行的接字(克罗特等,2001年;克罗特等,2007年;克罗特等,2004年)。 这里,类比相似性集再次是第一个成分的复合家族,就像CARIN理论中一样.

blocks.en: Analogical generalization offers two advantages for understanding compound semantics. First, analogical models can capture local generalizations ( Skousen, 1989 , cf.) and can find ‘islands of reliability’ ( Albright and Hayes, 2003 ) . Second, because generalization is based on local similarity neighborhoods, atypical formations such as hogwash are less likely to add noise to the system. In this study, we therefore explore whether analogy-based generalization can explain compound interpretation. We first report computational experiments comparing the accuracies of the CAOSS model and our new analogical model, henceforth the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), for both training data and held-out data. Subsequently, we evaluate measures derived from the two computational models against visual lexical decision latencies. The language that provides our test case is Mandarin Chinese. The next section introduces compounding in Mandarin Chinese.
blocks.zh: 逻辑通论为理解复合语义提供了两个优点. 首先,模拟模型可以捕捉本地的概括性(Skousen,1989年,参考),并且可以找到 " 可靠岛屿 " 。 (奥尔布赖特和海斯,2003). 其次,由于通俗化是基于局部相近的邻里,因此像霍格瓦什这样的非典型的形成不太可能给系统增加噪音. 因此,在本研究中,我们探讨基于类比的概括能否解释复合解释. 我们首先报告计算实验,比较CAOSS模型和新的模拟模型,即复合分析模型,用于培训数据和预留数据。 随后,我们对照可视的词典性决定延迟来评价从两个计算模型中得出的措施. 提供我们测试案例的语言是普通汉语. 下一节以普通话汉语介绍复合.

blocks.en: 2 Compounding in Mandarin Chinese
blocks.zh: 2 中文复合语

blocks.en: Mandarin Chinese is a language in which compounding plays a central role in lexical formation, accounting for approximately 70% of existing words (Institute of Language Teaching and Research, 1986) and around 95% of newly coined words ( Ceccagno, 2016 ) . Chinese is written with logograms (henceforth ‘characters’) that mostly correspond to spoken syllables. The vast majority of characters can be used as words on their own, but some ‘cranberry’ characters exist. For instance, in 尴尬 ( gan1ga4 , ‘awkward’), the first character is described as a “meaningless bound form” in the Pleco dictionary. An educated speaker, after extensive training, will know approximately 3,500 characters. As in Chinese texts words are not separated by spaces, Chinese readers also develop excellent skills in distinguishing words in sequences of characters. Thus, Chinese is a prime candidate for a language in which it is impossible not to see the constituent characters of compounds.
blocks.zh: 普通汉语是复合语在词汇形成中起中心作用的一种语言,约占现有词的70%(语言教学与研究学院,1986年)和约95%的新作词(Ceccagno,2016年). 汉语写作时所对应的对数图(以下简称"特征")大多对应口语音节. 绝大多数的人物可以自己当作词来使用,但有一些"cranberry"的人物存在. 例如,Pleco词典中第1个字符被描述为“无意义的约束形式”。 经广泛培训后,一位受过教育的演讲者将掌握大约3 500个人物。 和中文文本中"词"没有被空格相隔开一样,中国读者也发展出在字符序列中区分词的优秀技能. 因此,汉语是无法不看到化合物组成字符的语言的主要候选语言.

blocks.en: Individual characters tend to be highly polysemous. For instance, the character 生 ( sheng1 ) can function as a verb meaning ‘to become’ in 生病 ( sheng1bing4 , ‘to get sick’), as an adjective meaning ‘raw’ in 生鱼片 ( sheng1yu2pian4 , ‘sashimi’), and as a noun denoting a human referent in 学生 ( xue2sheng1 , ‘student’). Thus, the problem of constituents having multiple senses discussed by Schäfer and Bell (2020) for English is much exacerbated for Chinese (see Table 1 ). This extensive polysemy is especially challenging for global compositional rules, but it also highlights the potential importance of local analogical structure among families of compounds.
blocks.zh: 个人角色往往具有高度的多聚性. 例如,字符 § (sheng1)可以起到动词的作用,意思是 " 成为 " 在 ± (sheng1bing4, " to get sick " ),形容词 § (sheng1yu2pian4, " sashimi " ) 和名词 学生 (xue2sheng1, " sudent " ) 。 因此,Schäfer和Bell(2020年)讨论的成分对英语有多种感官的问题在中文方面严重地恶化了(见表一)。 这种广泛的多聚体对于全球构成规则来说尤其具有挑战性,但也突出了局部类似结构在化合物家族中的潜在重要性.

blocks.en: Chinese compounds exhibit diverse morphological structures ( Ceccagno and Basciano, 2007 ; Ji and Gagné, 2007 ) , including modifier-head (e.g., 热心, re4xin1 , ‘warm-hearted’), coordinate (e.g., 父母, fu4mu3 , ‘parents’), verb-object (投资, tou2zi1 , ‘investment’), subject-predicate (e.g., 地震, di4zhen4 , ‘earthquake’), and verb-resultative constructions (e.g., 缩小, suo1xiao3 , ‘shrink’). Whereas in English modifier-head compounds predominate, the position of functional heads in Chinese is remarkably free ( Shen and Baayen, 2026 ) .

Previous computational studies addressing computationally the interpretation of Mandarin compounds include Hsieh et al. (2024) and Wang and Xu (2025) . The former study examined the predictive power of two measures for semantic transparency derived from a CAOSS model for visual lexical decision latencies, and reported that higher transparencies afforded shorter response latencies. In what follows, we will report in detail how we replicated and extended their findings. The latter study took a large language model based on a bidirectional transformer ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) for Chinese, that was post-trained to predict 300-dimensional embeddings obtained with word2vec, building on the NOTCH model ( Tseng and Hsieh, 2022 ) . Wang and Xu (2025) reported excellent prediction accuracy and also showed that measures based on their model out-performed the CAOSS model, as applied to Chinese by Hsieh et al. (2024) , for predicting lexical decision latencies. Their model, however, addresses a question that is very different from the question addressed by the CAOSS model, and that is also central to the present study. The CAOSS model focuses on how well constituent embeddings predict compound embeddings for embeddings that all come from the same semantic space, thereby addressing the question of semantic compositionality. By contrast, the NOTCH model takes characters as input, uses a bi-directional transformer with more than 300 million parameters to obtain a 1024-dimensional vector that is subsequently mapped onto a 300-dimensional word2vec vector that itself was trained on different textual data. As a consequence, the NOTCH model is not optimal for understanding the human cognition of compound interpretation. In what follows, we therefore do not follow up on this line of research, and instead consider what can be achieved with simpler models working with straightforward (non-contextualized) embeddings that all belong to the same semantic space.
blocks.zh: 以往关于计算普通话化合物解释的计算研究包括Hsieh等人(2024年)和Wang和Xu(2025年)。 前一项研究审查了从CAOSS模型中得出的关于视觉词典性决定延迟的两种语义透明度措施的预测力,并报告说,较高的通译率提供了较短的反应延迟。 在下文中,我们将详细报告我们如何复制和扩大调查结果。 后一研究以双向变换器(Devlin等,2019年)为汉语取出一个大型语言模型,经过后期的训练,可以预测用单词2vec得到的300维嵌入,以NOTCH模型(Tseng和Hsieh,2022年)为基础. Wang和Xu(2025年)报告了出色的预测准确性,还显示基于其模型的测量超过了Hsieh等人(2024年)适用于中国人的CAOSS模型,用于预测词法决定延迟. 然而,其模式涉及的问题与阿拉伯撒哈拉和萨赫勒观测所模式所处理的问题大相径庭,这也是本研究的中心内容。 CAOSS模型侧重于组成成分嵌入如何预测嵌入的化合物嵌入,这些化合物都来自同一个语义空间,从而解决了语义组成问题. 相形之下,NOTCH模型将字符作为输入,使用一个有3亿多参数的双向变压器来得到一个1024维向量,这个向量随后被映射到一个300维的单词2vec向量上,而这个向量本身就接受了不同文字数据的培训. 因此,NOTCH模型对理解复合解释的人类认知性并不理想. 因此,在下文中,我们不跟踪这一条研究线,而是考虑用简单模型与直接的(非文字化的)嵌入(它们都属于同一个语义空间)合作能够实现什么。

blocks.en:
The CAOSS model (Compounding as Abstract Operations in Semantic Space; Günther and Marelli, 2019 ; Günther and Marelli, 2020 ; Günther and Marelli, 2023 ) is a data-driven compositional model that represents compound meanings as linear combination of the embeddings of their constituents. For a two-constituent compound, the model assumes that its meaning can be computed as a weighted sum of the meanings of its constituents, using least squares multivariate multiple regression ( Marelli et al., 2017 ) .
Formally, the CAOSS model works with three matrices with embeddings as row vectors: • 𝑺 \bm{S} : an n × k n\times k matrix of k k -dimensional embeddings for n n compounds; • 𝑺 1 \bm{S}_{1} : an n × k n\times k matrix with the embeddings of the n n compounds’ first constituents; • 𝑺 2 \bm{S}_{2} : an n × k n\times k matrix of the embeddings of the n n compounds’ second constituents.

blocks.zh: 3.2 复合分析模型

blocks.en: Previous studies addressing the distributional semantics of derived words reported that for transparent affixes, the embeddings of words with these affixes cluster together in semantic space. Furthermore, the vectors from the base word to the corresponding derived word, henceforth shift vectors also cluster in the embedding space. This suggests that the meaning of a derived word can be represented as the sum of the vector of its base and its average shift vector, see, e.g., Drozd et al. (2016) . However, more refined conditional shift vectors may be required, see Shafaei-Bajestan et al. (2024) and Chuang et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 以前关于衍生词的分布语义的研究报告说,对于透明的语义,用这些语义集群一起嵌入到语义空间中的词. 此外,从基词到相应的衍生词的向量,从此之后,向量也会在嵌入空间中集群. 这表明出自词的含义可以被表示为基数的向量与平均向量相和,参见德罗兹德等(2016年). 然而,可能需要更精细的有条件转向向量,见Shafaei-Bajestan等 (2024)和Chuang等 (2023).

blocks.en: The Compound Analogy Model (CAM) proposes that compound semantics operate on the similar additive principles. This model starts out from the observation that Mandarin compound families sharing a constituent form clusters in both the semantic space of compound embeddings and the corresponding shift vector space ( Shen and Baayen, 2026 ) . One such cluster is illustrated in Figure 2 . The center panel illustrates the clustering in a t-SNE map of the embeddings of two-character compounds containing 水 ( shui3 , ‘water’, in blue) together with compounds with other high-frequency mono-morphemic words (shown in grey). The left panel illustrates a shift vector, and the right panel presents the shift vectors for 水. The shift vectors of 水 also show considerable clustering. The existence of these clusters suggests that in Mandarin, the semantics of compound constituent families are remarkably consistent and coherent, in ways similar to what has previously been observed for semantically transparent derivational and inflectional affixes ( Stupak and Baayen, 2022 ; Nikolaev et al., 2022 ; Chuang et al., 2023 ) . Importantly, the centroid of the cluster of compound embeddings with a given compound constituent (水 in Figure 2 ) represents the prototypical meaning of compounds with this constituent. Furthermore, the centroids of the shift vectors of given compound constituents, e.g., 水, represent the prototypical change in meaning that such constituents contribute to the compounds in which they occur.

blocks.en: The CAM model proposes that the meaning of a compound can be predicted from the embeddings of its constituents and the centroids of the shift vectors of these constituents. We illustrate the model for the compound 学生 ( xue2sheng1 , ‘student’). In this example, we assume that the left and right constituent families have exactly 5 members, with 6-dimensional embeddings. (The actual constituent families are much larger, 50 and 122, and the actual embeddings are 200-dimensional.) Figure 3 illustrates how the shift vector for the left constituent is calculated. blocks.en: Since both CAOSS and CAM operate on constituents, and as constituent structure is not indicated in the CLD, we segmented character strings into their immediate constituents as follows. For two-character compounds, the first and second characters were directly assigned as first and second constituents. Three-character words can be left-branching (e.g., 价目表 ( jia4mu4biao , ‘price list’, consisting of the two-character compound 价目 ‘price item’ and the one-character constituent 表 ‘list’), right-branching (老朋友 ( lao3peng2you3 , ‘long-time friend’, consisting of the one-character constituent 老 (‘old/long-time’) and the two-character compound 朋友 (‘friend’), or not branching (e.g., 对不起 ( dui4bu4qi3 , ‘sorry’) and 木乃伊 ( mu4nai3yi1 , ‘mummy’). Constituent boundaries were determined based on a lookup table of two-character words. If only one two-character sequence (either the first–second or the second–third characters) existed in the two-character word dictionary, the word was segmented accordingly. When both adjacent two-character sequences of a three-character word were found in the two-character word list (15.1% of all segmentable 3-character strings), the two-character word with the highest frequency was selected. When neither candidate bigram existed in the two-character word dictionary, the three-character word was treated as non-segmentable. Overall, 85.7% of the three-character words were segmentable (66.3% left- branching, 19.4% right-branching). The remaining 14.3% of non-segmentable words, pose a challenge for both the CAOSS and CAM models, were excluded from further analysis.

blocks.en: Of interest to us are both how well a model predicts for known words, and how well it predicts for novel words it has not encountered during training. The higher the accuracy of the model for known words is, the more regular and transparent the lexical system is, and the less it depends on memorization. The more accurate model predictions are for held-out data, the more productive the compound system is. We therefore implemented a cross-validation set-up with 30 runs in which 10% of the words were randomly selected as held-out data and training proceeded on the remaining 90% of the words. In this way, for both training and held-out data, a point estimate of accuracy is obtained, as well as insight into the variability around this point estimate.
blocks.zh: 我们感兴趣的是,一个模型对已知词的预测有多好,对新词的预测有多好,它在培训期间没有遇到。 模型对已知词的准确度越高,词典体系的规律性和透明度越高,对记忆的依赖就越少. 模型预测对于被搁置的数据越准确,复合系统就越有成效. 因此,我们实施了一个交叉验证设置,共30个运行,其中10%的字被随机选取为被搁置的数据,其余90%的字被进行培训。 这样,对于培训和预留数据,就能得到精确度的分数估计,以及围绕这一分数估计的可变性的深入了解。

As expected, prediction accuracy decreased for both models when evaluated on the held-out datasets. CAM outperformed CAOSS by a small but well-supported margin (means = 0.17 vs. 0.16, t ⁡ ( 29 ) = − 8.99 , p < 0.001 t(29)=-8.99,p<0.001 ). Comparing performance on training and test data, CAM would seem to overfit more than CAOSS, as the magnitude of the reduction in accuracy from training to testing is greater. Nevertheless, accuracy on both training and testing data is higher for CAM.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Prediction accuracy for CAM and CAOSS models for training and test data. For each of 30 runs, data were randomly split into training (90%) and test (10%) sets.
blocks.zh: 图6:用于培训和测试数据的CAM和CAOSS模型的预测准确性。 每30次考试,数据都随机分为培训(90%)和测试(10%)两组。

blocks.en: In these analyses, the selection of held-out data was completely random. As a consequence, both higher-frequency and lower-frequency words are included in the held-out datasets. In the actual experience of language users, however, most higher-frequency words are familiar, whereas the lower-frequency compounds, which are more likely to be unfamiliar, pose challenges for interpretation. We therefore ran a second experiment on the full dataset, in which we implemented a single split, with the training data containing the 90% most frequent words, and the held-out data containing the 10% lowest-frequency words. In this way, we can evaluate to what extent knowledge acquired from the more frequent compounds generalizes to the less-frequent compounds. Figure 7 shows that CAM outperformed CAOSS not only on the training set of familiar compounds (0.45 vs. 0.19, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , proportions test), but also on the low-frequency compounds in the test set (0.12 vs. 0.09, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , proportions test).
blocks.zh: 在这些分析中,被搁置数据的选择完全是随机的. 因此,高频和低频词都包含在被搁置的数据集中. 然而,在语言使用者的实际经验中,大多数高频单词是熟悉的,而频率较低的复合词则更有可能不熟悉,对口译构成挑战. 因此,我们进行了关于完整数据集的第二次实验, 我们实施了一个单一的拆分, 培训数据包含90%最频繁的词, 和被搁置的数据包含10%的最低频率词。 这样,我们就可以评估从更频繁的化合物获得的知识在多大程度上概括到更频繁的化合物。 图7显示,CAM不仅在熟悉的化合物培训组上(0.45对0.19,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001,比例测试),而且在测试组中的低频化合物上(0.12对0.09,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001,比例测试)都超过了CASS。

blocks.en: Considered jointly, these analyses indicate that the CAM model provides superior precision for known words, and somewhat enhanced precision for novel words, as compared to the CAOSS model: the CAM model is more productive, albeit by a small (but non-negligible) margin.
blocks.zh: 这些分析表明,与CAOSS模型相比,CAM模型为已知单词提供了更高的精度,对新单词的精度也有所提高:CAM模型更有成效,尽管有很小(但不可忽略)的比分.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Prediction accuracy of CAM and CAOSS under a frequency-based split with the lowest-frequency 10% of compounds in the test set and the remaining 90% in the training set.
blocks.zh: 图7:CAM和CAOSS的预测精度按频率划分,试验组中最低频率为10%,其余90%在训练组中。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Performance by word length
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 国家 按字长分列的业绩

blocks.en: We next split the data by word length into three subsets: a subset of two-character words (33,844), a subset with three-character words (6,008), and a subset with four-character compounds (2,274). For each of these three subsets, a CAM and a CAOSS model was constructed. Figure 8 summarizes prediction accuracy of CAM and CAOSS across the three word lengths for both training and test sets. For two-character compounds, CAM (mean accuracy = 0.38 for training and 0.17 for test) outperformed CAOSS (mean accuracy = 0.18 for training and 0.14 for test) on both the training ( t ⁡ ( 29 ) = 840.6 , p < 0.001 t(29)=840.6,p<0.001 ) and test sets ( t ⁡ ( 29 ) = 27.7 , p < 0.001 t(29)=27.7,p<0.001 ). For three-character compounds, CAM achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on the training set (mean accuracy = 0.94 vs. 0.71), t ⁡ ( 29 ) = 374.36 , p < 0.001 t(29)=374.36,p<0.001 ). On the test set, however, CAOSS (mean accuracy = 0.53) outperformed CAM (mean accuracy = 0.47; t ⁡ ( 29 ) = − 19.76 , p < 0.001 t(29)=-19.76,p<0.001 ). For four-character compounds, CAM again showed higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both the training set (mean accuracy = 0.99 vs. 0.94; t ⁡ ( 29 ) = 136.08 , p < 0.001 t(29)=136.08,p<0.001 ), and the test set (mean accuracy = 0.69 vs. 0.67; t ⁡ ( 29 ) = 3.33 , p = 0.002 t(29)=3.33,p=0.002 ).

blocks.en: Overall, prediction accuracy increased with compound length for both CAM and CAOSS, with nearly perfect performance on the training data for CAM. For the test data, accuracy was around 17% for two-character words, which increased to around 47% for three-character words, and to around 68% for four-character compounds. Clearly, longer compounds are more semantically transparent, and offer better generalization.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,随着CAM和CAOSS的复合长度增加,CAM培训数据的性能几乎完美。 就测试数据而言,两个特征词的准确度约为17%,三个特征词的准确度增至47%左右,四个特征化合物的准确度增至68%左右。 显然,较长的化合物具有更清晰的透明性,并提供更好的概括。

blocks.en: However, the variability in prediction accuracy also increases with word length: In Figure 8 , the boxplots for the held-out data become wider for increasing word length. This is likely due to increasing data sparsity.
blocks.zh: 然而,预测准确性的变化也随着字长的增加而增加: 在图8中,为增加字数长度,用于搁置数据的框块会变得更宽。 这可能是由于数据疏通性增加。

blocks.en: A similar pattern of results emerged when the lowest-frequency 10% of compounds were assigned to the test set and the remaining higher-frequency compounds were assigned to the training set (Figure 9 ). CAM significantly outperformed CAOSS on the training sets across all three word lengths. With respect to the low-frequency held-out data, a significant difference was present only for the two-character compounds (see Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 当将10%的最低频率的化合物分配到测试组,将剩余的高频化合物分配到培训组(图9)时,也出现了类似的结果模式。 在三个字长度的培训中,CAM的成绩大大超过CASS。 关于低频阻断数据,只有两种特征化合物存在显著差异(见表2)。

Across word lengths, the majority of compounds were nouns. Restricting the analyses to the compounds tagged as nouns again resulted in very similar results, as shown in Figure 10 , with CAOSS outperforming CAM only for the test data of three-character compounds. 5 5 5 Very similar results were obtained for test sets with the lower frequency words. Details are available in the supplementary materials at https://osf.io/cg745/overview?view_only=07d00fe3a49440bcb130024b5443aabf . The variance in the accuracies for held-out data were quite large for the four-character compounds, which may trace back to unreliability in the tagger (see footnote 4 .).
Overall, accuracies for nouns were slightly higher than the accuracies for the full datasets.

blocks.en: 4.4 Vector length
blocks.zh: 4.4 矢量长度

blocks.en: Figure 11 visualizes the distributions of the L2-norms of the gold-standard embeddings for constituents and compounds (red boxplots) and the distributions of L2-norms of the transcended constituent vectors and the predicted compound vectors (blue boxplots) for CAOSS (left panel) and for CAM (right panel). The correlation of the predicted and observed L2-norms of the compounds was 0.33 for CAOSS and 0.44 for CAM. Apparently, the CAM model more precisely approximates compounds’ L2-norms.
blocks.zh: 图11可视化地显示成份和化合物(红花板)所嵌入金标准L2-规范的分布情况,以及超越成份向量的L2-规范的分布情况和CAOSS(左面板)和CAM(右面板)所预计的化合物向量(蓝花板)的分布情况。 预测和观测到的化合物L2-标准的相关性为CAOSS0.33和CAM0.44。 显然,CAM模型更准确地接近化合物的L2规范.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Distributions of the vector lengths (L2-norms) for CAOSS (left panel) and CAM (right panel), for transcended (blue) and observed (red) constituent embeddings, as well as for the predicted and observed compound vectors.
blocks.zh: 图11:CAOSS(左面板)和CAM(右面板)的矢量长度(L2-规范)的分布,用于超越(蓝色)和被观察到(红色)成分嵌入,以及预测和被观察到的复合矢量.

blocks.en: It is noteworthy that for CAOSS, the L2-norms of the transcended constituent vectors as well as the L2-norms of the compounds are systematically shorter than their empirical counterparts. For the constituents, this is not problematic by itself, as the original embeddings and their transcended counterparts are not directly comparable. However, for the predicted compounds, a comparison is legitimate, and reveals that the compound embeddings predicted by CAOSS are substantially shorter than those of the corresponding gold standard vectors.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,对于CAOSS来说,超越成分矢量的L2规范以及化合物的L2规范系统比经验性对应物短. 对组成者来说,这本身并不有问题,因为原始嵌入物及其超越的对应物并不具有直接可比性。 然而,对于预测的化合物来说,进行比较是合理的,并表明CAOSS预测的化合物嵌入比相应的金本位矢量要短得多。

blocks.en: For CAM, on the other hand, the transcended constituent vectors are somewhat longer than the original constituent embeddings, and the predicted compound vector is somewhat shorter than its gold-standard counterpart. Absolute divergences are smaller for CAM compared to CAOSS. In sum, with respect to vector length, CAM outperforms CAOSS.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,对于CAM来说,被超越的构成矢量比原始成份嵌入体长一些,而所预测的化合物矢量比它的金标准对应物要短一些. 与CAOSS相比,CAM的绝对差异较小. 总而言之,在矢量长度方面,CAM比CAOSS要好。

blocks.en: An important property of the empirical compound embeddings is that their L2 norms are smaller than would be expected from a simple additive composition of the constituent embeddings. Under an additive model, combining two constituent vectors would generally result in a compound representation with a larger norm,  as under independence the expectation of a sum is the sum of the expectations. However, the empirical compound vectors are substantially shorter than this additive expectation, indicating that the semantics of compounding involve a kind of compression rather than a simple accumulation of constituent information.
blocks.zh: 经验化合物嵌入物的一个重要属性是它们的L2规范比组分嵌入物的简单添加剂成分所预期的要小. 在添加剂模型下,将两个组成矢量结合起来一般会导致一种具有较大规范的复合代表,因为独立情况下,对一个和数的预期是期望的总和。 然而,实证化合物向量大大短于这种添加剂的预期值,表明化合物的语义涉及某种压缩,而不是简单的组成信息的积累.

blocks.en: 4.5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.5 讨论情况

blocks.en: A comparison of the accuracy of CAOSS and CAM on the full dataset revealed that CAM substantially outperforms CAOSS on training data, and that it also performs slightly but significantly better on held-out data. However, when the dataset is partitioned by the number of characters in a compound, results changed. First, accuracies increased substantially, approaching 1.0 for the training data with CAM and CAOSS for 4-character words. Second, for the 3-character words, CAOSS outperformed CAM on the held-out data. The reason for these changes becomes apparent when the family sizes of the left and right constituents are considered.
blocks.zh: 对CAOSS和CAM在整套数据集上的准确性进行比较后发现,CAOS在培训数据方面的表现大大超过CAOSS,在被搁置的数据方面也表现略好但明显好一些。 然而,当数据集被一个复合体中的字符数分割时,结果会发生变化. 首先,速率大大增加,使用CAM和CAOSS的培训数据接近1.0,4个特征词。 第二,对于3个特征词,COSS在被搁置数据上的表现超过了CAM. 如果考虑到左右成分的家庭大小,这些变化的原因就变得很明显了。

blocks.en: For two-character compounds, median constituent family sizes are 4 for both the left and right constituents, and the percentage of constituents that occur only in 1 compound is 28% for both the left and right character. However, for 3-constituent words, the constituent families are extremely small: for the left constituent, the mean and median are 1.6 and 1 respectively, and for the right constituent, mean and median are 6.4 and 2. The percentages of constituents that only occur in one compound (henceforth ‘hermits’) are 70.1% for the first constituent and 49.1% for the second constituent. These numbers are even more extreme for the 4-character compounds: 93% of the left constituents and 89% of right constituents occur in a single compound only.
blocks.zh: 对于两个特征的化合物,左右成分的中位组成家族大小为4个,而只有1个化合物的成分百分比,左右特征的成分为28%. 然而,对于3个构成的字,组成家庭则极小:对于左组分,平均和中位数分别为1.6和1;对于右组分,平均和中位数分别为6.4和2. 只存在于一种化合物(以下简称 " hermits " )的成分百分比为:第一个成分为70.1%,第二个成分为49.1%。 这些数字对于4个特征的化合物更为极端:93%的左组分和89%的右组分只存在于一个单一的化合物中.

blocks.en: The CAOSS model is also challenged by the data sparsity for longer compounds. Figure 12 illustrates that for two-character compounds, the submatrices 𝑾 1 \bm{W}_{1} and 𝑾 2 \bm{W}_{2} are rather similar to diagonal matrices. The proportion of the Frobenius norm of 𝑾 \bm{W} that is contributed by the diagonal elements of 𝑾 1 \bm{W}_{1} and 𝑾 2 \bm{W}_{2} is roughly 72.8%. 6 6 6 For a dataset with 4817 English compounds, this proportion is much smaller: 9.6%. For the three and four-character compounds, the proportional contribution of the diagonal elements decreases slightly to 65.4% and 59.1%. Clearly, for longer compounds, off-diagonal elements are more important, and make more precise prediction possible for compounds that likely are more transparent.

blocks.en: In the light of these considerations, it is not straightforward to evaluate the differences in the performance of the CAM and CAOSS models on held-out data. The better performance of CAOSS for 3-character words and the better performance of CAM for 4-character words may be just a coincidence that is contingent on the longer words that happened to be included in the CLD. It is also possible that an asymmetry in the constituent family sizes is at issue. Denoting the left and right constituent family sizes, excluding the target compounds themselves, by V 1 V_{1} and V 2 V_{2} respectively, an index of asymmetry for all compounds of a given length is asym = median ​ ( log ⁡ ( V 1 + 1 ) − log ⁡ ( V 2 + 1 ) ) . \text{asym}=\text{median}(\log(V_{1}+1)-\log(V_{2}+1)). (21) For the 2-character words, this index is 0.97, for the 3-character words it is 1.87, and for the four-character words it is basically 0. As this asymmetry index is the greatest for the 3-character compounds, it is conceivable that the analogy model works less well for held-out data when constituent family sizes are unbalanced.

(21) 对于"二相"字,本索引为0.97;对于"三相"字,为1.87;对于"四相"字,基本为0. 由于这种不对称指数对于3个特征的化合物来说是最大的,因此可以想象,当组成家庭规模不平衡时,类比模型对于被搁置的数据作用不大。

blocks.en: Finally, consider the performance of CAM and CAOSS for training data. Whereas from a machine learning perspective, generalization to unseen data is a critical desideratum, from a cognitive perspective, accuracy on training data is equally informative. If performance on training data is very low, this suggests that the semantic regularities exploitable by the present model are limited for the compounds that speakers frequently produce and listeners routinely understand. In this case, lexical processing is likely to depend more heavily on rote learning and memorization. Conversely, the better a model captures the representations of common words, the more it suggests that regularities in the semantic space can support lexical processing, thereby reducing the burden on memory. From this perspective, the CAM model provides a better account of the structure present in the training data than the CAOSS model.
blocks.zh: 最后,考虑CAM和CAOSS在培训数据方面的表现。 虽然从机器学习的角度来看,将数据归纳到看不见是关键的偏差,但从认知的角度来看,培训数据的准确性同样具有信息性。 如果在培训数据方面的性能很低,这表明,对于发言者经常制作的化合物和听众经常理解的化合物,本模型可以利用的语义周期性是有限的。 在这种情况下,词典处理很可能更依赖于转子学习和记忆. 反之,模型越能捕捉到常见词的表达,就越能暗示语义空间中的规律性可以支持词典处理,从而减轻记忆的负担. 从这个角度看,CAM模型比CAOSS模型更好地说明了培训数据中的结构.

blocks.en: 6 General Discussion
blocks.zh: 6 一般性讨论

blocks.en: The CAOSS model ( Günther and Marelli, 2019 ; Günther et al., 2020 ) proposes that the cognitive system predicts the meaning of a compound from the meanings of its constituents, using a linear transformation operating on word embeddings. The present study proposes an alternative model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that is grounded in analogical reasoning over the compound families of the constituents of compounds. For each of a compound’s constituents, the CAM model starts out with the embedding of that constituent and adds to this the centroid of the shift vectors of that constituent’s compound family members. This is done for both constituents, resulting in two — CAM-based —‘transcended’ ( Libben, 2010 ; Libben, 2014 ) constituent meanings, which are averaged to obtain the predicted embedding of the compound.
blocks.zh: CAOSS模型(Günther and Marelli, 2019;Günther等,2020年)提出,认知系统从其成份的含义来预测一个化合物的意义,使用在词嵌入上操作的线性转变. 本研究提出了一个替代模型 -- -- 复合自学模型(CAM),其基础是对化合物组成成分的复合系进行模拟推理。 对每种化合物的成分来说,CAM模型始于该成分的嵌入,并增加了该成分复合家族成员的转移载体的中间体。 这对两个成分都是如此,结果产生了两个-基于CAM的-X-transcent. (Libben, 2010; Libben, 2014) 组成意义,平均得到该化合物的预测嵌入.

blocks.en: CAOSS and CAM do not merely differ in their computational implementation; they instantiate different assumptions about the cognitive processes involved in compound interpretation. CAOSS assumes that semantic composition can be captured by a learned transformation operating across compounds, whereas CAM assumes that speakers exploit local regularities emerging from lexical neighborhoods.
blocks.zh: CASS和CAM不仅在计算执行上有所不同;它们即时对复合解释所涉及的认知过程作出不同的假设。 CAOSS假设语义成分可以通过跨化合物的有学问的转化来捕捉,而CAM则假设说者利用由词汇学街区产生的局部规律.

blocks.en: We evaluated the CAOSS and CAM models on a dataset of Mandarin compounds. We first considered prediction accuracy. For both models, performance was worst for words with two single-syllable constituents, and increased substantially for compounds with three or four single-syllable constituents (henceforth, ‘characters’, as provided by the simplified Mandarin logographic writing system). The CAM model consistently outperformed CAOSS on training data, and also outperformed the CAOSS model for held-out data with 2 and 4 characters. It was only for 3-character words for held-out data that CAOSS provided higher accuracy as compared to CAM. We also examined vector length, using the Euclidean length of the vector, i.e., its L2-norm. The L2 norms of the predicted compound embeddings were shorter than those of their gold-standard counterparts. The difference in length was substantially larger for the CAOSS model than for the CAM model. Considered jointly, these computational experiments indicate that the CAM model is a competitive alternative to the CAOSS model. Unlike CAOSS, which requires estimating a 200 × 400 200\times 400 linear transformation matrix (80,000 parameters) to map concatenated constituent embeddings into the compound space, CAM is a non-parametric analogy-based model that nevertheless generalizes well to unseen compounds.
blocks.zh: 我们在一套普通话化合物的数据集上评估了CAOSS和CAM模型. 我们首先考虑了预测的准确性。 对于这两种模型来说,使用两个单音节元件的单词性能最差,而使用三个或四个单音节元件的化合物(以下简称 " 特征 " ,由简化的普通话记录书写系统提供)性能则大大提高。 CAM模型在培训数据方面一直优于CASOS,在2个和4个字符的被搁置数据方面也优于CASOS模型。 与CAM相比,CAOSS提供的准确性更高,只是针对被搁置数据的3个特征词。 我们还利用矢量的Euclidean长度,即它的L2-Norm,检查了矢量长度。 预测的化合物嵌入物的L2规范比其黄金标准对应物的规范要短. CAOSS模型的长度差异大大大于CAM模型。 这些计算实验共同认为,CAM模型是CAOSS模型的一种竞争性替代品。 与CAOSS不同,CAOSS需要估算出200×400 200\times 400线性变换矩阵(80,000个参数)来映射嵌入化合物空间的同位素组成物,CAM是一种非参数类比模型,不过它还是将通俗化为看不见的化合物.

blocks.en: Although for both CAOSS and CAM, accuracy increased for compounds with more than two constituents, upon closer inspection the two models performed differently for these longer words as compared to the two-character compounds. Constituent families are extremely small for compounds with three or four characters. As a consequence, the analogical basis for CAM-based generalization is often reduced to a single compound exemplar for each constituent, and analogy collapses. Thus, for the CAM model, predictions for three or four character compounds in the training data are therefore based on the compound itself whenever the compound families of the constituents have only one member. For held-out data, the compound embedding predicted by CAM reduces to just the mean of the two constituent embeddings. In other words, for longer words, the analogy motivating CAM degenerates. Nevertheless, the model provides predictions that are competitive with those of CAOSS.
blocks.zh: 虽然CAOSS和CAM两种化合物的精度都有所提高,但经过更仔细的检查,这两个模型对这些较长的词的精度与两个特征化合物的精度不同。 对于有三到四个字符的化合物来说,组成家族是极小的. 因此,基于CAM通化的类比基础往往被降低为每个成分的单一化合物实例,而类比崩溃. 因此,就CAM模型而言,培训数据中对三到四个字符复合物的预测,只要组成物的复合物家族只有一个成员,就以复合物本身为基础。 对于被搁置的数据,CAM所预测的复合嵌入物会降低到仅仅是两个成分嵌入物的平均值. 换句话说,用更长的话来说,刺激CAM的类比已经退化了。 然而,该模型提供的预测与阿拉伯撒哈拉和萨赫勒办事处的预测有竞争力。

blocks.en: The small constituent families for longer words also affect the performance of CAOSS. Inspection of the constituent-specific transformation matrices of CAOSS shows that for 2-character words, these matrices mainly implement addition of the constituent embeddings: the diagonal elements have large values, whereas off-diagonal elements have very small values. In other words, the two transformation matrices are close to identity matrices. Interestingly, for 3 and 4 character words, the CAOSS matrices have more larger off-diagonal weights, indicating that for these longer words, CAOSS is picking up some general systematicities and is not just adding up the embeddings of the constituents. As the longer compounds are semantically more transparent, the CAOSS model appears to come into its own for exactly the semantically more regular words.
blocks.zh: 篇幅较长的小型组成家庭也会影响CAOSS的表现. 对CAOSS特定组成变换矩阵的检查表明,对于两个特征词,这些矩阵主要执行组成嵌入的添加:对角元素的值很大,而对角元素的值很小. 换句话说,两个变换矩阵接近身份矩阵. 有趣的是,对于3和4个字符单词,CAOSS矩阵的离对角分量更大,表明对于这些较长的单词,CAOSS正在取出一些一般的系统,而不只是将成分的嵌入相加. 由于较长的化合物在成分上更加透明,因此CAOSS模型似乎完全为成分上更常态的词而出现.

blocks.en: Hsieh et al. (2025) showed that the cosine similarities of the transcended constituent embeddings and the predicted compound embedding, the first and second constituent proximities, are predictive for visual lexical decision latencies to Chinese compounds written with traditional Chinese characters. We replicated their results with compounds written with simplified Chinese characters, improving on their regression model by allowing lexical predictors to have non-linear effects, using the generalized additive model ( Wood, 2017 , GAM,) . We also documented an effect of the cosine similarity of the predicted and gold standard compound embeddings, in a non-linear interaction with the family size of the second constituent. Inspection of the geometry of the proximity measures, the effects of which were linear, revealed that they approximate the L2 norm (length) of the predicted compound vector, and that when the proximity measures are replaced by the L2 norm of the predicted embedding, model fit improves. These findings raise questions about what exactly the CAOSS proximity measures tap into. They may gauge not much more than the amount of evidence for lexicality: embeddings with near zero length, which are close to the origin of the semantic space, are not well-learned and not well-distinguishable from nonwords in the visual lexical decision task. The positive correlation of embedding length and word frequency fits well with this explanation. The only evidence for a semantic transparency effect for visual lexical decisions would then be the small effect of the cosine similarity of the observed and predicted compound vectors.
blocks.zh: Hsieh等(2025年)显示,超越成份嵌入和预测的化合物嵌入的同位素相似性,即第一和第二个成份相近性,对于用传统汉字书写的中国化合物的视觉地语法决定后期是预测性的. 我们用简化汉字的化合物来复制它们的结果,通过允许词汇预测器具有非线性效果来改进它们的回归模型,使用通用添加剂模型(Wood, 2017, GAM,). 我们还记录了预测和金本位化合物嵌入的同位素相似性,在与第二个成分的家庭大小的非线性相互作用中产生的效果。 对相近度量的几何学的检查,其效果是线性的,发现相相近于所预测的化合物向量的L2规范(长度),而相近度量被所预测的嵌入的L2规范所取而代之时,模型适配性会得到改进. 这些调查结果提出了关于CAOSS的近距离措施究竟利用什么的问题。 它们可能仅能衡量词典性的证据量: 近于零长度的嵌入物与语义空间的起源相近,没有很好的了解,与视觉词典决定任务中的非名词没有很好的区别. 嵌入长度和文字频率的正相关关系与这个解释完全吻合. 因此,视觉语法决定的语义透明度效应的唯一证据是所观测和预测的复合向量的同位素相似性所产生的小效应。

blocks.en: A GAM with CAM-based predictors outperformed the GAM with CAOSS-based predictors by more than 20 AIC units. This model included a tensor product smooth for the two proximity measures, and also included the cosine similarity of predicted and observed compound embeddings, again in interaction with the family size of the second constituent. These results indicate that the CAM model is a worthy competitor of the CAOSS model not only as a computational algorithm, but also when the task is to predict lexical decision times.
blocks.zh: 具有基于CAM的预测器的GAM比基于CASOS的预测器的GAM有超过20个AIC单位的性能. 这个模型包括两种相近测量的拉伸产能平滑,还包括了预测和观测到的化合物嵌入的同位素相近性,再次与第二个成分的家族大小相互作用. 这些结果显示,CAM模型不仅是作为计算算法的CAOSS模型的值得竞争者,而且当任务是预测词汇决定时间时也是如此.

blocks.en: The present findings have several implications for theories of lexical processing. First , there is no way in which the meanings of two-character compounds can be predicted with sufficient accuracy from the meanings of their constituents. Accuracy is at 25% for CAOSS, and better for CAM, but still only at 50%. As a consequence, theories positing obligatory decomposition for reading cannot fall back on a general computational algorithm that will predict the meaning of a compound from the meanings of its decomposed parts.
blocks.zh: 目前的调查结果对词典处理理论有几种影响. 首先,无法从组成物的含义中充分精确地预测出两种特征化合物的含义。 CASOS的准确度为25%,CAM的准确度更高,但仍只有50%。 因此,假定对阅读进行强制分解的理论不能回到一般计算算法上,该算法将从化合物分解部分的含义中预测化合物的含义。

blocks.en: Since both CAOSS and CAM operate on embeddings, the question arises of how in the lexical decision task these embeddings are obtained from the visual input. What is required is some mechanism that takes one or more characters as input, and produces the corresponding embeddings. One such mechanism is provided by a linear mapping that predicts embeddings from character n-grams. We therefore trained such a network on the two-character compounds and their single-character constituent words in our dataset (see section 4.1 , using the JudiLing package Heitmeier et al. (2026) . With end-state learning (multivariate multiple regression) and form embeddings based on character bi-grams, the network model performs with 100% accuracy. In other words, if attention is focused on the first character (requiring decomposition), the network produces the embedding of the first character, and if attention is focused on the two characters jointly (whole-word processing), it will deliver the embedding of the compound. It turns out that when the L2-norms of the compound embeddings predicted by this network are added as a predictor to the GAM with CAM-based predictors, AIC decreases by some 96 units, supporting the involvement of a direct route from a compound’s written form to its embedding. This simple network thus offers a useful approximation of how during reading the embeddings that constitute the input for the CAOSS and CAM models, are obtained during the reading of two-character compounds.
blocks.zh: 由于CAOSS和CAM都使用嵌入法,因此产生了一个问题:在逻辑决定中,这些嵌入法是如何从视觉输入中获取的。 所需要的是一些将一个或多个字符作为输入,并产生出相应嵌入的机制. 其中一种机制是通过线性映射提供的,预测从字符n克的嵌入. 因此,我们在数据集中就两个特征的化合物及其单一特征组成词培训了这样一个网络(见第4.1节,使用JudiLing包Heitmeier等(2026年))。 随着结束状态学习(多变多回归)并基于字符二克而形成嵌入,网络模型以100%的精度进行. 换句话说,如果将注意力集中在第一个字符上(需要分解),网络会产生第一个字符的嵌入,如果将注意力集中在两个字符上共同(全字处理),则会提供复合的嵌入. 结果发现,当这个网络预测的化合物嵌入物的L2-规范被加入到基于CAM的预测器中作为GAM的预测器时,AIC会减少大约96个单位,支持从一个化合物的书面形式到嵌入的直接路径的参与. 因此,这种简单的网络提供了一种有益的近似方法,说明在读取构成CAOSS和CAM模型输入的嵌入物时,如何在读取两种特征化合物时获得。

blocks.en: Second , as pointed out by Schäfer and Bell (2020) for English, the higher the uncertainty in analogical reasoning is about the concept represented by the head noun (based on the analogical set of compounds sharing that head noun), the greater the diversity of interpretations is across speakers, and the more these speaker struggle to come up with a meaning for a novel compound. We anticipate that in the CAM model, the quality of the cluster of shift vectors for the head will capture part of this insight. The more widespread in semantic space the shift vectors of compounds sharing a given head are, the more noisy the centroids of these shift embeddings are expected to be, and the more uncertainty there will be concerning what a constituent’s prototypical semantic contribution is.
blocks.zh: 第二,如Schäfer和Bell (2020)所指出,模拟推理中的不确定性越高,以头名词为代表的概念越多(基于对头名词共享的化合物的模拟组合),解释的多样性越多,这些演讲者越是挣扎想出一个小说复合的意义. 我们预计,在CAM模型中,头部移向矢量群的质量将捕捉出这一洞察力的一部分. 在语义空间中,共享一个给定头的化合物的转动向量越是普遍,这些转动嵌入物的百分位行星预期会越吵,而且对于一个成分的原型语义贡献的不确定性就越大.

blocks.en: Third , the CAM model is an analogical model, and thus has the potential of accounting for key findings motivating the CARIN theory of conceptual combination ( Gagné and Shoben, 1997 ; Gagné et al., 2005 ) . Consider, for instance, the made of relation in compounds such as silk shirt, cotton shirt, corduroy shirt, flannel shirt , and linen shirt . The shift vectors from the materials to shirt will originate in a cluster of clothing materials in semantic space, and the centroid of the corresponding shift vectors may well capture what it means for a shirt to be made of something. 8 8 8 However, just as English plural shift vectors vary depending on the semantic class of the noun ( Shafaei-Bajestan et al., 2024 ) , made of shift vectors are expected to vary consistently depending on the type of object involved. Thus, wooden chair, metal chair, plastic chair, leather chair are expected to have a different centroid shift vector than compounds such as silk shirt, cotton shirt, corduroy shirt, flannel shirt , and linen shirt . An important caveat for analogical models addressing the structure and meaning of compounds is that for compounds with more than two constituents, the basis for analogical reasoning can shrink rapidly to just single exemplars. This is not an issue just for CAM model, but extends to the CARIN model and to models for compound stress ( Plag, 2010 ) and for models predicting the choice of interfixes in German and Dutch compounds ( Krott et al., 2001 ; Krott et al., 2004 ) . 9 9 9 Technically, this problem can be attenuated by increasing the set of compounds taken into consideration. For instance, Wang and Xu (2025) trained their implementation of the NOTCH model on some 500,000 words, obtaining excellent prediction accuracy. However, it is unlikely that individual language users know, or would need, such a huge vocabulary in order to understand compounds. The Modern Chinese Dictionary ( Dictionary Editorial Office of the Institute of Linguistics, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, 2016 ) contains approximately 65,000–70,000 lexical entries that are in common usage in the language community, but the vocabulary of individual speakers, depending on their level of education, is likely to be considerably less. Our dataset comprises some 33,800 words, which we conjecture to be already overestimating the lexical knowledge of many educated speakers.
blocks.zh: 第三,CAM模型是一种模拟模型,因此有可能对推动CARIN理论概念结合的关键结果进行核算(Gagné和Shoben,1997年;Gagné等人,2005年)。 以丝绸衬衫、棉衬衫、衬衫、花纹衬衫和亚麻衬衫等化合物为例。 从材料到衬衫的转向载体会发源于语义空间的一组衣物材料,相应的转向载体的中间体很可能捕捉出衬衫由某种东西所制成的意义. 8 8 然而,正如英语复数向量因名词的语义类别而异(Shafaei-Bajestan等,2024年)一样,由转向向量制成的向量预计会因所涉物体的种类而变化一致. 因此,木椅、金属椅、塑料椅、皮革椅与诸如丝绸衬衫、棉衬衫、地铁衬衫、法兰绒衬衫和亚麻衬衫等化合物相比,有不同的百分位转移矢量。 处理化合物结构和含义的模拟模型的一个重要注意是,对于具有两个以上成分的化合物,模拟推理的基础可以迅速收缩到仅仅是单个实例. 这不仅仅是CAM模型的问题,而是延伸至CARIN模型和化合物应力模型(Plag,2010年)以及预测德国和荷兰化合物间接物选择的模型的问题(Krott等人,2001年;Krott等人,2004年)。 第9条 从技术上讲,这个问题可以通过增加考虑到的化合物数量而得到缓解。 例如,王和徐(2025年)对NOTCH模型的实施进行了约50万字的培训,获得了出色的预测准确性. 然而,个别语言使用者不太可能知道或需要这样一个庞大的词汇来理解复合体. "现代汉语词典"(中国社会科学院语言研究所词典编辑室,2016年)收录了语言界常用的约6.5万至7万个词典条目,但个别讲词者的词汇,视其受教育程度而定,很可能要少得多. 我们的数据集包括约33,800个字,我们推测这些字已经高估了许多受过教育的演讲者的词汇知识。

blocks.en: Fourth , the CAOSS model is conceptualized in a general approach to morphology in which each word formation process is associated with its own linear transformation. For derived words, the FRACCS model ( Marelli and Baroni, 2015 ) proposes a linear transformation that takes the embedding of the base word as input, and delivers the embedding of the derived word as output. With respect to compounds, the CAOSS model generalizes this approach for the case that there are two ‘base words’. However, the FRACCS model has been observed to overfit and to fail to generalize well to test data ( Stupak and Baayen, 2022 ) . The present study documents a similar problem for Mandarin compounds. A further problem is that it is far from clear how the cognitive system would know when to set up the individual transformation matrices. Should English un- attached to adjectives, meaning ‘not’, and un- attached to verbs, meaning ‘reverse previous action’ be handled by the same transformation? What about comparative -er and agent nouns with -er ? Ideally, one would want to avoid having to hand-engineer these kind of decisions. The CAM model, on the other hand, straightforwardly generalizes to derivation, and does not require setting up separate mechanisms for individual affixes and compounds. A property of derived words is that the constituent families of affixes tend to be much larger than those of the constituents of compounds. When an affix is transparent, the centroid of its shift vectors will be well-defined and support generalization. At the same time, the morphological family of the base word, which typically is orders of magnitude smaller, can also be taken into account, just as in the case of compounds.
blocks.zh: 第四,CAOSS模型是概念化的形态学一般方法,其中每个词的形成过程都与自己的线性转变有关. 对于衍生词,FRACCS模型(Marelli and Baroni, 2015)提出以嵌入基词为输入的线性转换,并交付衍生词为输出的嵌入. 关于化合物,CAOSS模式将这种方法概括为有两个 " 基词 " 的情况。 然而,据观察,FRACCS模型过于合适,无法很好地概括测试数据(Stupak和Baayen, 2022年)。 本研究记录了普通话化合物的类似问题. 另一个问题是,还远不清楚认知系统如何知道何时建立单个变换矩阵。 英文不附在形容词上,意为"不是",而未附在动词上,意为"逆向前作",这是否应该通过同样的转变来处理? 比较 -er和代理名词与 -er? 理想的情况是,人们会希望避免不得不进行这类决定。 另一方面,CAM模型直截了当地概括为衍生,不需要为单个的辅料和化合物建立单独的机制. 衍生出词语的一个属性是:辅词的组成家族往往比化合物的组成家族大得多. 当一个后缀是透明的时,其转向向量的中间体会得到很好的定义并被支持通化. 同时,基词的形态学家族,一般是数量级更小的,也可以考虑,就像化合物一样.

blocks.en: Returning to compounding in Mandarin, it is surprising that analogical reasoning can get the meanings right for nearly half of the two-character compounds on which it is ‘trained’. Many two-character words are very opaque. Consider, for example, 马虎, ma3hu1 , ‘careless’, has no relation with any constituent meaning of 马 ‘horse’ nor 虎 ‘tiger’. In the case of 如果 ( ru2gou3 ), the first character has meanings such as ‘be in compliance’, ‘like’, ‘exceed’, and ‘for instance’, and the second constituent realizes meanings such as ‘fruit’, ‘result’, ‘consequence’, ‘as expected’. The meaning of 如果 is simply ‘if’.
blocks.zh: 回到普通话的复合体,令人惊讶的是,模拟推理能够正确理解它所“训练”的近一半两个特征复合体的含义。 许多两个特征的词非常不透明. 例如,认为---(ma3hu1),- " 粗心 " ,与--(马)-(马)-(马)-(虎)-(虎)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(虎)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)-(马)- 在"##"(ru2gou3)中,第一个角色有"遵守","像","超越","例如"等含义;第二个角色实现"水果","结果","顺序","如所期望"等含义. 如果的意思只是"如果".

blocks.en: Nevertheless, in spite of the many two-character words that severely challenge any L2 learner of Chinese, there is considerable analogical structure in the repository of two-character words. This structure is too local to allow robust generalization to unseen two-character compounds. Longer compounds are considerably more transparent than many two-character compounds (e.g., 电话号码, dian4hua4-hao4ma3, ‘telephone number’), and unsurprisingly, prediction accuracy increases substantially for both CAOSS and CAM.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,尽管许多"双相"字严重地挑战了任何L2汉语的学习者,但"双相"字的寄存处仍有相当的类似结构. 这种结构局部性太强,无法使强通化到看不见的双特征化合物. 较长的化合物比许多两种特征的化合物(例如: ;dian4hua4-hao4ma3; " 电话号码 " )要透明得多,而且毫不奇怪,CAOS和CAM的预测准确性都大大提高。

blocks.en: In summary, we have made a case that compound interpretation is grounded in local analogical generalization. For familiar compounds, analogical generalisation may exploit systematicities in the semantic space to support compound interpretation, complementing the compound embeddings as directly accessed from their written forms. For novel compounds, the models may provide the gist of the intended meaning. However, as shown by Schäfer and Bell (2020) for English, understanding a novel compound is most likely to heavily depend on the context of use, rather than on de-contextualized constituent embeddings.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们已经证明,复合解释基于当地模拟概括。 对于熟悉的化合物而言,模拟通论可能利用语义空间中的系统来支持复合解释,补充从书面形式直接取入的化合物嵌入. 对于新颖的化合物,模型可能提供意图含义的要旨. 然而,如Schäfer和Bell(2020年)所显示的,理解一款小说复合体最有可能严重地依赖于使用的背景,而不是去通体化的组分嵌入.
